title: buddleja elegans subsp. angustata
intro: Buddleja elegans subsp. angustata, commonly known as the narrow-leaf butterfly bush, is a plant species belonging to the Buddleja genus, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The narrow-leaf butterfly bush has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Buddleja elegans subsp. angustata include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its ability to ease muscle spasms, reduce swelling, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the lungs. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
